_note: Toolchain artifacts are pinned PER HOST, because the artifact differs per host: `downloads` is a list of {host_id, url, checksum, checksum_algorithm, verified}. A single download_url per candidate was wrong and had already gone wrong -- the native Windows pass filled Go's one field with a windows-amd64 zip, which would have made the lock read as if Go were pinned to a Windows artifact on every host. An entry EXISTS only when the bytes were downloaded and hashed and the digest matched the vendor's published value; a host with no entry is simply not yet pinned, which is unambiguous in a way the old UNVERIFIED sentinel string was not. `checksum_algorithm` is recorded rather than assumed: Microsoft publishes SHA-512 for .NET SDK artifacts while Go, Rust and Astral publish SHA-256. A fabricated checksum is worse than an absent one.
